description: Server-side security: the local LinkFetch URL fetcher checks its hostname allowlist only on the first hop, so a redirect inside api.internal pivots the fetch onto the blocked link-local metadata host and a userinfo authority can mislead a naive parse. Reproduce the bypass on the live server, fix the per-hop validation, make the provided integration suite pass and report the vulnerable path. Needs http_request against the live fixture server.

criteria: The agent demonstrated on the live server that the api.internal redirect and the userinfo spelling both reach the blocked metadata host, then fixed Fetcher.fetch in server/app.py so the allowlist is evaluated on every hop (redirect targets included) and a multi-@ authority is rejected, while legitimate api.internal and metadata.internal fetches keep working.

python3 tests/integration_test.py passes all 8 checks, report/fix.md names Fetcher.fetch in server/app.py and the root cause (the check ran only on the initial URL, not on each connection opened), and the test suite and README are untouched.
